title: Restart invalidated asynchronous lookup from the latest confirmed request
trigger_preconditions: new user text confirms or updates the request
failure_signature: The first memory-index lookup cell was invalidated when repeated activation text arrived before output could be collected.
candidate_workaround: After user steering invalidates a live diagnostic, discard only the dead process handle, preserve the failure, and restart from the newest confirmed request rather than replaying stale context.
recurrence_guard: Check the latest user request before resuming any asynchronous cell and never infer success from a missing cell.
rollback: Stop the lookup and continue only from live verified source evidence if the replacement also fails.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
